title: Fallbrook Riders Field
specs: Courses and arenas set up for multiple riding disciplines including English, Western, Eventing, Jumping, Obstacles, Rail, and Pleasure
Hosts recognized dressage shows and jumper schooling events
Must be a member to access the field except on public horse show days
All riders under 18 years must wear an SEI approved helmet; helmets strongly recommended for all riders
Professional trainers must be certified and have insurance endorsement naming Fallbrook Riders as Additionally Insured
All students of member trainers must be current members; no non-members allowed on grounds
Facility available for private events, weddings, dog shows, car shows, art shows, BBQs, and corporate picnics

blurb: Fallbrook Riders Field is a members-only equestrian facility where members can practice riding disciplines, school young horses, and participate in events such as dressage and jumper shows. The field includes courses and arenas for English, Western, Eventing, Jumping, Obstacles, Rail, and Pleasure riding. The facility also hosts fundraising events and offers memberships with access to the field and events.
extraNote: No guests or non-members allowed access except on public horse show days · Late entries for dressage shows incur a $30 late fee and are accepted at manager's discretion; no refunds · Gate code changes annually and is sent only to current members with full application and payment · Manure and trash must be cleaned up by users; manure buckets and forks provided · Fallbrook Riders Field, 1627 So Stagecoach Lane, Fallbrook, CA
